backend: MongoDB 8.0.32 loopback replica set, majority write concern, primary reads
latency_definition: Produce callback to complete business Event callback; includes client admission, excludes final RPC drain
measurement_scope: client and local router share one process; MongoDB CPU/RSS measured separately; no speed comparison to old RPC or unbatched direct calls
operation: point reads of 256 preloaded BSON records, each 1 KiB pad
